verdicts.reason: A breaks the CTA apart: 'Join', 'WADE' and 'team' sit hundreds of pixels apart down the right edge. 'WE CREATE' is pushed beside 'MARKETING FUTURE' instead of above it, and the four decorative marks are lined up into a row that reads like an 'OIIX' logo. The maroon panel has become an empty box away from all the text. B also has the fake 'OIIX' row and the empty maroon box, but its headline stacks in the right order (though 'FUTURE' is slightly off the left axis). Its 'Join WADE team' stays on one line at the bottom, though the words are spread too far apart and sit on the busy photo.
